sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: This catalogue entry is Acer pseudoplatanus, sycamore maple. It is a large deciduous tree about 20–35 m tall. Opposite palmate leaves have five lobes and may reach about 18 × 26 cm.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Small flowers grow in hanging clusters. The paired-winged fruits are samaras about 2–6 cm long.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: Seeds and seedlings may expose horses to hypoglycin A, which is associated with atypical myopathy. The plate shows the maple leaves and paired samaras characteristic of the species.
